dct_description_sm: Funded by Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) Atlantic Ecosystems Initiatives (AEI), the Miramichi River Environmental Assessment Committee (MREAC) sampled for nutrients, Total Nitrogen and Total Phosphorus, and bacteria, Total Coliforms, Escherichia coli (E. coli), and Enterococcus on the Miramichi Watershed in 2021.
dct_title_s: Miramichi River Environmental Assessment Committee (MREAC) Atlantic Ecosystems Initiatives (AEI) Nutrient and Bacteria Sampling on the Miramichi Watershed 2021
